div.div:
Ălĭdensis , e, adj.,
I.of or pertaining to Alida or Alinda, a town in Caria, where splendid garments were manufactured; hence, ălĭdense (sc. vestimentum), a full dress, court-dress, Lucr. 4, 1130; where Lachmann read alidensia, a word not elsewhere found in Latin or Greek, and Munro now reads indusia; v. indusium.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
